interaction.question: does a better generation rule help R (5x timing signal) more than B?
interaction.caveat: each gain is one training seed per checkpoint; the difference of two gains has roughly twice the variance of either, so read the sign only if it is large
interaction.reading: HELPS BOTH ABOUT EQUALLY: generation is a separate, additive problem and the resolution spend remains unpaid-for.

verdict: **NO.** Capping the A-run does not improve pipe 2 across seeds (per-seed gains [28.2, -51.5, 32.5]). The corrected timing lift rose 5x with resolution and neither the lift nor a freer generation rule moves behaviour. **The lift itself is now the thing under suspicion** -- it would be the fourth estimator in this thread to fail, and the most consequential.
